svg.title: Memory file tree
svg.desc: The acme-app project repository and separate personal, team, and organization repositories have Git-folder icons and orange repo tags. All six .memories folder rows are highlighted blue. Outside labels describe the folders and files, and a Markdown preview shows a memory with multiple scopes.
